title: Admin Surface Design Guideline
summary: Binding admin-surface standard: flat full-bleed composition, compact disclosure-first headers, one grid for stream entries, non-redundant sober copy, project identity, operator-grade density, bounded prose width, theme tokens, and locally hosted fonts. Includes a fully specified Activity reference, a screenshot-backed violation audit, an incremental adoption contract, an explicit prohibition on nested outcome-summary boxes, the details-panel addendum, the append-only Navigation citizenship chapter with three light/dark Tree variants, a neutral waiting-decision counter recommendation, state rules, a follow-up slice boundary, visual Dos and Don'ts pairs, and an append-only Applied surfaces register. [Curated 2026-08-23: previous status/phase values ('living-standard'/'accepted') were not in the platform's allowed lifecycle vocabulary and made this descriptor invalid in the live Dossier catalogue - corrected to 'decided' with no phase. This is a living standard by design: it stays adopted and current, is amended in place as new surfaces land, and is not expected to move to History.]
statusReason: Previous status 'living-standard'/phase 'accepted' were out of the schema vocabulary and rendered this descriptor invalid. Corrected to decided with no phase (none of the four allowed phase values fit a living standard honestly). Stays adopted and current by design, amended in place; not expected to move to History.
